credit_metrics.text: EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2026}} to {{ebitda@FY2026}} on revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2026}}, but operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2026}} to {{operating_profit@FY2026}} as depreciation increased with a larger fleet.

watch_items.text: Leverage: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2026}} and gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2026}} remain well above the peer medians of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2026}} and {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2026}}, the weakest position in the group ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2026}}).
